requirements.title: A common block name in a scoping unit cannot identify a constant or intrinsic procedure there
requirements.definition: A name that identifies a common block in a scoping unit shall not be used to identify a constant or an intrinsic procedure in that scoping unit.

pending.common-block-name-not-constant: Source-control plan with COMMON /blk/ and a named constant blk in the same scoping unit; the control changes only the constant name. No mandatory diagnostic is claimed for this unnumbered program restriction.
pending.common-block-name-not-intrinsic-procedur: Source-control plan with COMMON /sin/ and an intrinsic procedure local identifier SIN in the same scoping unit; the control changes only the common block name. No mandatory diagnostic is claimed for this unnumbered program restriction.

requirements.title: A local identifier that matches a common block name denotes the local entity outside common-block-name contexts
requirements.definition: For a local identifier of class (1) that is also the name of a common block, any appearance of that name outside BIND, COMMON, or SAVE common-block-name contexts is an appearance of the local identifier.
requirements.oracle: S19.3.2-002 common-block homonym runtime fixture: one complete program declares COMMON /blk/ cb_member and a local integer blk. It initializes cb_member=29 and blk=17, evaluates ordinary expression blk+1 expecting 18, and checks cb_member remains 29, proving ordinary occurrences resolve to the local identifier rather than the common block.
requirements.oracle_limitation: S19.3.2-002 common-block homonym fixture boundaries: only the listed single-image positive runtime effects are claimed.
